'''Akeno Watanabe''' (Japanese: '''渡辺明乃''' ''Watanabe Akeno'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Watanabe was born on November 28, 1982 in {{wp|Funabashi (city)|Funabashi}}, {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Watanabe began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} near the end of {{aniseries|RS}}. Her most notable roles are {{Ash}}'s [[rival]] [[Trip]], as well as [[Ash's Scraggy]]. She is currently affiliated with Office Osawa.
